risk_description: AI synthesis may overstate confidence or flatten minority signals
Community-led language may be used without real decision authority
Framework may privilege measurable indicators over dignity and trust
Portfolio may transfer interventions across places without local adaptation
Board may review issues without authority to pause or redirect design work
Learning system may document issues without changing decisions
AI prototype may expose users to opaque or biased service decisions
Repair playbook may lack funding or implementation ownership
Research operations may optimize documentation over community accountability
Training may build skills without decision pathways or institutional absorption
